common.presentationLbl: Hi! I'm Max, and I'm passionate about acoustics and programming. I graduated from the Technical Degree in Programming at UTN and I am currently studying Sound Engineering at Untref. I have experience developing .NET systems with layered client-server architecture, using Razor MVC Views with Bootstrap on the frontend, and Entity Framework with SQL Server on the backend.
